boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named study environments across Lafayette’s Skillman and Kirby libraries, from designated quiet reading rooms to reservable rooms and a private booth.

cards.title: Settle Into the Oak-Paneled Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Kirby Library · Kirby Hall of Civil Rights
cards.notes: Bring reading or writing work and use the formal oak-paneled room; check Kirby’s separate calendar before crossing from Skillman.
cards.short_summary: A traditional library setting for focused reading beneath classical architectural details.
cards.evidence_claim: Lafayette identifies Kirby Library’s classically inspired, oak-paneled reading room as a space where students study.
cards.access_notes: Open only during Kirby Library hours, which are posted separately from Skillman’s and vary by date.

cards.title: Choose the Library’s Designated Quiet Room
cards.subtitle: Skillman Library · Upper level, Room 203
cards.notes: Use this designated quiet space for silent reading or concentrated writing, and relocate conversations to a collaborative area.
cards.short_summary: Skillman’s explicitly designated quiet room offers a formal setting for concentration.
cards.evidence_claim: Lafayette describes the Rothkopf Reading Room as a designated quiet space, and its upper-level plan locates it in Room 203.
cards.access_notes: Available during Skillman Library hours; observe its designated-quiet-space use.

cards.title: Read Beside the Tiffany Window
cards.subtitle: Skillman Library · Main level, Room 116
cards.notes: Pick a seat near the Alcuin and Charlemagne Tiffany window for individual work, but finish before the room’s overnight closure.
cards.short_summary: A named main-level room pairing study seating with a documented Tiffany window.
cards.evidence_claim: Lafayette identifies the Simon Room as a Skillman study setting and states that its Tiffany window depicts Alcuin and Charlemagne.
cards.access_notes: Within Skillman; Lafayette says the Simon Room closes at midnight when the library operates with 24-hour finals access.

cards.title: Start on Skillman’s Main-Level Reading Floor
cards.subtitle: Skillman Library · Main level
cards.notes: Use the named reading room for a book-heavy session, with the reference studio and other main-floor services close at hand.
cards.short_summary: A clearly named reading environment on Skillman’s service-rich main level.
cards.evidence_claim: Skillman Library’s official main-level plan identifies the Drinkhouse Reading Room beside the McCluskey Reference Studio.
cards.source_title: Skillman Library Named Spaces — Main Level
cards.access_notes: Available during Skillman Library hours; the official plan does not identify it as reservable.

cards.title: Work Near Research and Scanning Tools
cards.subtitle: Skillman Library · Main level
cards.notes: Base a source-heavy assignment here; nearby PCs include attached scanners, and librarian help is offered on posted service hours.
cards.short_summary: A research-oriented workspace with scanning access and proximity to library assistance.
cards.evidence_claim: Lafayette’s plan names the McCluskey Reference Studio, and the student FAQ says PCs at its north end have attached scanners.
cards.access_notes: Within Skillman Library; research-librarian service hours are narrower than building hours.

cards.title: Pair a Work Session With the Library Café
cards.subtitle: Skillman Library · Main level
cards.notes: Choose this common room when light refreshment suits the session; café service follows Dining Services hours, not library hours.
cards.short_summary: A social study setting containing Skillman’s café rather than a silent reading room.
cards.evidence_claim: Lafayette identifies the Nordberg Common Room on Skillman’s main level and states that the Skillman café is located inside it.
cards.access_notes: The room follows Skillman access; café hours are separate and a purchase is optional, not required to use the study setting.

cards.title: Take an Upper-Level Study Area
cards.subtitle: Skillman Library · Between Rooms 203 and 206
cards.notes: Set up between the Rothkopf and Gendebien rooms for an open upper-floor workspace without claiming an enclosed study room.
cards.short_summary: An open, named study area positioned between two upper-level rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Skillman Library’s official upper-level plan identifies Parsons Study Area between Rooms 203 and 206.
cards.source_title: Skillman Library Named Spaces — Upper Level
cards.access_notes: Available during Skillman hours; the official plan labels it a study area rather than a reservable room.

cards.title: Reserve an Enclosed Upper-Level Room
cards.subtitle: Skillman Library · Upper level, Room 217
cards.notes: Book ahead for enclosed work, or use the room vacant until a reservation holder arrives; keep the daily three-hour limit in mind.
cards.short_summary: A numbered upper-level study room governed by the library’s reservation rules.
cards.evidence_claim: Skillman’s upper-level plan identifies Ruthizer Study Room as Room 217; Lafayette permits study-room reservations.
cards.source_title: Skillman Library Named Spaces — Upper Level
cards.access_notes: Library rooms may be booked in half-hour increments for up to three hours per user per day, as far as three days ahead.

cards.title: Move Downstairs for a Named Reading Area
cards.subtitle: Skillman Library · Lower level
cards.notes: Bring sustained reading to this lower-level area, using the official floor plan to distinguish it from nearby rooms and study zones.
cards.short_summary: A named lower-level alternative to Skillman’s formal upstairs reading rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Skillman Library’s official lower-level plan identifies the Brenninger Reading Area as a distinct named space.
cards.source_title: Skillman Library Named Spaces — Lower Level
cards.access_notes: Available during Skillman Library hours; no reservation requirement is stated on the official floor plan.

cards.title: Book the White-Noise Study Booth
cards.subtitle: Skillman Library · Lower level near Room 004
cards.notes: Reserve this booth for solo work that benefits from added privacy, white noise, and integrated outlets; do not treat it as soundproof.
cards.short_summary: A reservable solo booth designed to dampen ambient noise while keeping devices powered.
cards.evidence_claim: Lafayette says the lower-level private study booth has white noise, integrated power outlets, and library-room-style reservations.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through the library’s LibCal system; the booth is near Room 004 and is private but not soundproof.
